title: The Agent Trajectory
description: Step through a DeFi AI agent's 8-step execution cycle as a TrajAD-style detector scores each step in real time. Inject a fault to watch a poisoned decision spike to 0.97 and trigger a bisection dispute game that isolates the bad step in 3 rounds.
controls: ⚡ Inject Fault — arm a prompt-injection on the next decision step
↺ Reset — start a fresh agent cycle
